experiment: DeepFM and small parallel DCN-v2 versus B2-size MLP
dcnv2_matrix: full rank, parallel cross and deep branches, no optional MoE
deepfm: field-specific linear weights + FM + DNN; FM and DNN share categorical, pooled-history and scaled numeric embeddings
lr_schedule: ReduceLROnPlateau on AUC, factor 0.5, patience 1, min_lr 0.00001
checkpoint: best validation AUC, not last epoch
source_history_rule: source day strictly before each advertisement day
preprocessing: reuse the independently fitted train-only vocabulary and scalers for each validation day
paper_adaptations: short history lists are mean-pooled fields, related IDs share embedding tables; not an exact reproduction of paper experiments
limitations: One random seed; both dates are offline validation folds used for best-epoch selection. The training windows overlap and the folds are not independent final tests.
